messages.content: 從一顆距離地球4光年的恆星發出的光需要多少時間才能抵達地球？

function.name: light_travel_time
function.description: Calculate the time taken for light to travel from a celestial body to another. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

But we can also provide the calculation: 4 light-years means 4 years. But if we want to be precise: 1 light-year = distance light travels in one year. So 4 light-years = 4 years. So answer: 4 years. But we can also convert to days or seconds. But the question: "從一顆距離地球4光年的恆星發出的光需要多少時間才能抵達地球？" The answer: 4 years. But we can also mention that it's about 4 * 365.25 days ~ 1461 days.
